headline: Mortgages: In Molise, Requests Are More Modest Than the National Average
summary: The average fixed mortgage rate rose to 3.46% in August, versus 2.80% for variable. On a 140,000-euro loan over 20 years, the fixed instalment is 47 euros higher.
why: Mortgage pricing reflects bank funding costs and the rate environment, and shifts between fixed and variable products affect household credit demand and bank lending.
